sidebar.row.means: A session's row in the left sidebar.

sidebar.activeRow.means: The sidebar row of the session the chat shows, highlighted.

sidebar.rowInScope.means: A session row under a sidebar section: activity:work is In work.

sidebar.anyRow.means: Any session row in the sidebar; pair it with text.

sidebar.anyActiveRow.means: Whichever sidebar row is highlighted as the open session.

sidebar.rowArchive.means: The Archive button a row shows on hover.

sidebar.rowMarkDone.means: The Mark done check a row shows on hover.

sidebar.newSession.means: The New session button at the top of the sidebar; opens a draft.

header.actions.means: The ... next to the session title above the chat; opens the session menu.

header.renameInput.means: The title field that Rename opens in place of the session title.

menu.item.means: An item of the open dropdown or context menu; pair it with text.

menu.option.means: A pick-one option of the open dropdown, such as Changed or Staged in the change mode menu; pair it with text.

dialog.button.means: A button of the open dialog; pair it with text.

dialog.field.means: A text field of the open dialog holding exactly value, such as the name Save as snippet suggests.

composer.multiRun.means: The x of the multi-run strip over the composer; it shows while the composer starts runs on several models.

chat.selectionMenu.means: A button of the menu over text selected in an answer: Comment, By the way, Add to notes; pair it with text.

dialog.checkbox.means: A checkbox of the open dialog, by its label.

composer.send.means: The round Send button at the end of the composer footer.

composer.stop.means: The Stop button that takes Send's place while the session works.

composer.model.means: The model name in the composer footer; opens the model picker.

composer.popup.means: The autocomplete list over the composer: commands after /, skills after $.

composer.mentionRow.means: A file in the @ mention list.

composer.mentionChip.means: A file chip in the composer after picking it from the @ list.

composer.projectPicker.means: The project picker above a new session's composer; pair it with its label, Choose project on a new Chat.

composer.projectOption.means: A project in the open project picker; pair it with the project's name.

picker.search.means: The search field at the top of the model picker.

picker.option.means: A model in the model picker; pair it with the model's name.

composer.status.means: The status line above the composer: Retrying in Ns, Warming up.

chat.message.means: One message of the transcript, user or assistant.

chat.userBubble.means: A prompt the user sent, as a bubble on the end side.

chat.answer.means: The text of an assistant answer.

chat.tool.means: The name of a tool call in its row: Read File, Search Files, Edit File, Shell Command.

chat.toolRow.means: A tool call row that expands on click: Edit File, Shell Command.

chat.toolDiffLine.means: An added line in an expanded Edit File row.

chat.fileLink.means: A file path in an answer, rendered as a link.

chat.copy.means: The copy button under an assistant answer; it shows when the answer is hovered.

chat.promptCopy.means: The copy button under a user prompt; it shows when the prompt is hovered.

chat.promptTime.means: The time a prompt was sent, left of its buttons on hover.

chat.promptMore.means: The ... under a user prompt; opens Select messages, Pin, Fork from here, Save as snippet.

chat.promptToggle.means: The Show more / Show less link under a long prompt.

chat.footer.means: The line under a turn's final answer: model, agent, duration, then the actions on hover.

chat.footerBranch.means: The footer button whose menu forks the session or starts a new session or multi-run from the answer.

chat.footerPin.means: The footer pin that keeps the answer in context; pressed true once pinned.

chat.footerMore.means: The footer ...: Copy link, Save as image, Select messages, Save as plan.

chat.changedFilesToggle.means: The +N chip after the first changed files; it shows the rest, and then hides them again.

chat.answerDivider.means: The thin line between a turn's steps and its final answer.

chat.selectionBar.means: The bar Select messages opens over the composer: the count and the export actions.

toast.means: A toast notification; pair it with its text.

chat.reasoning.means: A Thinking block in the transcript, folded to its first line; pair it with the reasoning's text.

chat.stepCopy.means: The copy button in the row under each answer text when Settings, Chat shows message actions on every reply; index picks the reply.

chat.revert.means: The revert button under a user prompt; it shows when the prompt is hovered.

chat.scrollToBottom.means: The arrow that appears when the chat is scrolled up.

chat.scroller.means: The scrolling area of the transcript.

chat.navigator.means: The ticks at the top start corner of a chat with three prompts or more; a click opens the list of prompts.

chat.navigatorPrompt.means: A prompt in the open prompt list; pair it with the prompt's text.

chat.search.means: The field of the search bar Cmd/Ctrl+F opens over the chat.

chat.searchCount.means: The N of M count next to the chat's search field.

chat.loadOlder.means: The button at the top of a chat whose older history is not loaded yet.

chat.liveTail.means: The chat while it follows a streaming reply: the transcript fades out above the composer.

chat.parent.means: The Parent button at the top start corner of a subagent's chat.

chat.readOnlyBanner.means: The banner in the composer's place in a chat that takes no prompts: Subagent sessions cannot be prompted.

chat.readOnlyStop.means: The Stop button on the read-only banner while that session works.

chat.openSubtask.means: The arrow on a subagent's tool row that opens its session.

chat.loadError.means: The message a chat shows in place of the transcript when its messages failed to load.

chat.loadRetry.means: The Try again button under a chat's failed load.

chat.sidePanelChat.means: A chat open in the context panel beside the main one, such as a subagent's.

composer.floating.means: The composer floating over the end of a session's transcript.

composer.centered.means: The composer standing in the page instead of over a transcript: a new session's draft or the expanded editor.

draft.heading.means: The heading over a new session's draft on the phone: What should we build in <project>?

draft.starter.means: A starter chip under the draft heading; a click sends its prompt.

timeline.entry.means: A message in the Conversation Timeline dialog; a click scrolls the chat to it.

workStatus.means: The Work status card beside the chat: session, context, project and branch.

chat.table.means: A Markdown table in an answer.

chat.heading.means: A Markdown heading in an answer.

chat.code.means: A fenced code block in an answer.

chat.listItem.means: A list item in an answer.

chat.error.means: A message in the transcript; pair it with the error text a failed turn shows.

panel.means: The context panel on the right of the chat.

panel.surface.means: A context panel button on the right rail: diff is Changes, editor is Files, git is Git.

panel.surfaceOn.means: A rail button whose surface is open.

files.row.means: A file or folder row in the Files tree.

files.modified.means: The M mark of a file with uncommitted changes in the Files tree.

files.search.means: The search field above the Files tree.

files.searchResult.means: A file the Files search found.

files.tab.means: An open file's tab above the editor.

files.line.means: A line of the open file.

files.preview.means: A Markdown file shown rendered (Preview) in the Files panel.

files.added.means: The A mark of a file git does not track yet in the Files tree.

files.openMark.means: The dot at the end of a Files tree row whose file is open in a tab.

files.selectedRow.means: A Files tree row painted as the selected file or as the folder a drag would land in.

files.folderError.means: The row a folder shows in place of its files when listing it failed, with a Refresh button.

files.folderRetry.means: The Refresh button on a folder's listing error row.

files.listItem.means: A line in the Files tree's message list: Loading, No files found, the list error with Refresh; pair it with text.

files.listRetry.means: The Refresh button the Files tree shows in place of a project listing that failed.

files.tree.means: The scrolling area of the Files tree; its empty space below the rows is the project's root folder for drops.

files.searchMode.means: The magnifier at the start of the Files search field; opens File names / File contents.

files.searchContents.means: The Files search field while it searches file contents.

files.searchClear.means: The x at the end of the Files search field.

files.searchRegex.means: The .* toggle in the Files search field while it searches contents.

files.add.selector: [data-right-slot] section:has(input[placeholder^="Search"]) button[aria-label="New file, folder, or upload"]
files.add.means: The + next to the Files search field: New File, New Folder, Upload Files.

files.more.means: The ... next to the Files search field: Show gitignored files, Refresh, Collapse all folders.

files.dropNote.means: The note over the Files tree during a drag: Upload to <folder>, Move to <folder>.

files.previewTab.means: A file tab in preview: its name in italics, replaced by the next file opened with one click.

diff.mode.means: The Changed: N switch at the top of Changes.

diff.file.means: A changed file's header in Changes; a click expands or collapses it.

diff.added.means: An added line in a diff (the code column, not the line numbers).

diff.removed.means: A removed line in a diff (the code column, not the line numbers).

diff.split.means: A diff shown side by side.

diff.unified.means: A diff shown as one column.

diff.sideBySide.means: The side-by-side toggle on a file's header.

diff.line.means: Any row of a diff's code column: added, removed or unchanged context; pair it with text.

diff.selectedLine.means: A diff row painted as selected for a comment.

diff.lineComment.means: The + in the gutter of the diff row under the pointer; opens a comment on that row or on the selected rows.

diff.commentField.means: The text field of the comment opened on diff rows.

diff.commentSave.means: The Attach button that saves the comment being written.

diff.comment.means: A saved comment shown under its rows: header with the range, then the text.

diff.commentOnLine.means: A saved comment anchored under a row: side additions or deletions, line its number on that side (the last row of a range).

diff.expandContext.means: The separator between two hunks in the line-number gutter; a click shows the unchanged lines it hides.

diff.hunkStage.means: The Stage button over hunk N (1-based) of an unstaged diff; it shows while the pointer is on the hunk.

diff.hunkDiscard.means: The Discard button over hunk N (1-based) of an unstaged diff; it asks to confirm.

find.input.means: The Find in changes field that Cmd/Ctrl+F opens over Changes.

find.count.means: The N/M count of matches next to the find field.

find.next.means: The down arrow of the find bar: the next match.

find.close.means: The x that closes the find bar.

find.mark.means: A find match painted inside a diff row.

find.currentRow.means: The diff row holding the active find match; pair it with the row's text.

settings.switch.means: The switch of a Settings row, by its search anchor (sessions.agent-workflow-tool).

settings.checkbox.means: The checkbox of a Settings row, by its search anchor.

workflow.card.means: A workflow run's card in the chat; pair it with its state's text (Waiting for you, Running, Stopped, Not run).

workflow.button.means: A button on a workflow run's card; pair it with its text (Run workflow, Don't run, Stop).

sidebar.settings.means: The gear at the bottom of the left sidebar that opens Settings.

sidebar.anyRowInScope.means: Any session row under a sidebar section (activity:work is In work); pair it with text.

sidebar.childCount.means: The count of sessions an agent runs for its own work on its row: how many are running and how many finished.

sidebar.expandChildren.means: The chevron that opens the sessions nested under a row.

sidebar.anyChildCount.means: The worker count on an agent's row, whatever it says.

sidebar.workRow.means: A worktree's or space's own row in the sidebar, named by its task or branch; the label is the start of that name.

phone.sessions.means: The list button at the top left of the phone layout; opens the drawer with sessions and projects.

phone.row.means: A session's row in the phone's session drawer; a long press opens its menu.

phone.anyRow.means: Any session row in the phone's drawer; pair it with text.

phone.childCount.means: The worker count on an agent's row in the phone's drawer.

phone.anyChildCount.means: The worker count on an agent's phone row, whatever it says.

phone.expandChildren.means: The chevron that opens the sessions nested under a phone row.

phone.workRow.means: A worktree's row in the phone's drawer, named by the start of its task or branch; a long press opens its menu.

operator.doneQuestion.means: The question Done asks while sessions an agent runs for its own work still run: stop them or let them finish.

chat.sidePanelScroller.means: The scrolling transcript of the chat in the context panel.

chat.sidePanelAnswer.means: The text of an answer in the chat in the context panel.

chat.formOption.means: An answer of a question the agent asks, shown as a card at the end of the transcript; pair it with its label.

chat.formSubmit.means: The Submit button of a question card at the end of the transcript.

settings.search.means: The search field at the top of Settings.

settings.chip.means: A choice of a Settings row that offers a few, by the row's search anchor; pair it with its label.

settings.chipOn.means: The chosen choice of that row; pair it with its label.

chat.sidePanelAllowOnce.means: Allow once on a permission request shown in the chat in the context panel.

chat.sidePanelEditor.means: The composer's text field of the chat in the context panel.

settings.searchResult.means: A result of the Settings search in the list on the left; pair it with its title.

chat.fold.means: The Activity header of a turn in Collapsed activity mode; a click opens or closes the turn's tool rows.

chat.foldOpen.means: An Activity header whose fold is open.

chat.anyToolRow.means: A tool call row anywhere in the transcript, the row of a !command the user ran included; pair it with text.

chat.changedFile.means: A file the turn changed, as a pill under the latest turn's answer (Settings > Chat: changed files).

chat.toolOpenFile.means: The arrow after a file tool's name in its row (Edit File, Write File); opens the file in Files.

chat.toolOpenAtChange.means: The pencil an opened file change row shows on hover; opens the file in Files at its first changed line.

chat.toolOpenDiff.means: The pull request icon an opened file change row shows on hover; opens the file's diff in Changes.

chat.toolCopyOutput.means: The copy button over a tool's output in an opened row (a command's output, JSON).

chat.toolJsonView.means: A view switch over a tool's JSON output: view navigable (a summary), formatted (a tree) or raw (the text).

chat.toolAction.means: A button inside an opened tool row; pair it with its text (Show the raw answer, Show the summary).

chat.toolCall.means: A call in the Tool calls list of an opened Script row; pair it with the tool's name.

chat.toolStop.means: The red Stop at the end of a tool row whose command or subagent still runs.

panel.chatTab.means: A tab of the context panel, such as a subagent's chat opened from its row; pair it with its label.

sidebar.rowMain.means: The title part of a session row: the button that opens it, double-click renames.

sidebar.rowSlot.means: The empty slot left of a row's title, part of the row's box outside its controls.

sidebar.rowFilled.means: A row drawn with the selection fill; a session listed twice is filled once.

sidebar.rowPicked.means: A row picked in Select sessions mode.

sidebar.rowUnpicked.means: A row not picked in Select sessions mode.

sidebar.rowBold.means: A row whose title is bold: a finished turn nobody read, or a request waiting on the user.

sidebar.rowRunning.means: The running mark of a row whose turn is in progress.

sidebar.rowUnread.means: The unread mark of a row with a finished turn nobody has seen.

sidebar.rowRunTime.means: The elapsed time a running row shows.

sidebar.rowTurnTime.means: The finished turn's duration an unread row shows.

sidebar.rowPermission.means: The shield on a row whose agent waits for a permission.

sidebar.rowQuestion.means: The question mark on a row whose agent waits for an answer.

sidebar.rowPinned.means: The pin mark of a pinned session's row.

sidebar.rowTrack.means: The eye a done row shows on hover; puts the session back in In work.

sidebar.rowDelete.means: The Archive button while Shift is held: it deletes the session at once.

sidebar.collapseChildren.means: The open chevron of a row with subsessions; hides them.

sidebar.rowRename.means: The title field a sidebar row turns into while renamed.

sidebar.rowRenameSave.means: The check that saves a row's new title.

sidebar.displayMode.means: The sidebar header's display menu: Select sessions, Detailed rows.

tooltip.means: An open tooltip; pair it with text.

panel.answer.means: An assistant answer shown in the right panel, as a session opened in the side panel.

sidebar.rowMainInScope.means: The title part of a session row under a sidebar section: activity:work is In work.

sidebar.folderNameInput.means: The name field of a sidebar folder being named.

sidebar.openFolder.means: An open sidebar folder by its name; a click closes it.

sidebar.rowGoal.means: The target mark of a row whose session works toward a goal.

sidebar.rowTitle.means: The title text of a session row alone; pair it with text and exact to read the whole title.

sidebar.page.means: A page link at the top of the left sidebar (Archive, Stats); pair it with its exact name.

archive.page.means: The Archive page; pair it with a session title to find it among the archived ones.

composer.attach.means: The paperclip at the start of the composer footer; opens Attach files and the link pickers.

composer.editorAs.means: The composer's text field by the placeholder it shows: Enter shell command... in shell mode, Ask in this btw session… in a by-the-way chat.

composer.attachmentChip.means: An attached file's chip in the composer's text, by the file's name.

composer.dropNote.means: The note over the composer while files are dragged onto it: Drop files here to attach, Drop to insert as mention.

composer.queue.means: The queued message row on top of the composer while the agent works; pair it with the message's text.

composer.queueButton.means: A button of the queued message row: edit, send; pair it with its text.

composer.control.means: A menu of the composer footer: the model, thinking, the agent; pair it with its text (Build, Plan).

composer.permissions.means: The shield in the composer footer, by the mode it names: ask every time, or the auto-accept one.

composer.historySearch.means: The field of the prompt history search Cmd/Ctrl+Arrow Up opens over the composer.

composer.historyRow.means: A prompt in the prompt history search; pair it with its text.
